All — looping in to propose a sequencing that minimizes cold handoffs and gives the coding interviewer a fresh context. Ethan asked to move coding to 10:45; here's a recommended flow: 

- 09:30–10:15 — System design (Laura) — 45m deep dive, capture top-level trade-offs
- 10:30–11:30 — Coding pair (Chloe) — 60m, start at 10:45 if Chloe needs a short prep window (we can invite at 10:35)
- 12:00–12:30 — Product/role (Neha) — 30m, focused on product sense & team fit
- 13:30–14:00 — Leadership/closing (Rishi) — 30m w/ 15m buffer after coding for notes

This stretches the day a bit but gives a 15–30 minute buffer after the coding slot for quick debrief capture before product. We should also add a "handoff note" doc that the coding interviewer can summarize in 5 bullets into the shared folder immediately after.

If Chloe can start at 10:45, I'll lock calendar. Otherwise we compress to AM and do two 90m blocks (design + coding) then a single 60m interview after lunch for product+leadership combined. Thoughts?

- Laura
Director, Engineering Hiring Programs
